service.method: SELECT TRANSACTION_CODE ,ADD_USER_ID ,FUNCTION_NAME ,START_DATE ,START_TIME ,END_DATE ,END_TIME ,STATUS ,MESSAGE ,DOC_TYPE ,DOC_NUMBER ,DOC_SEQ FROM SIF_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND START_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND START_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND STATUS IN($INS{F_STATUS}) AND ( 1=1 AND TRANSACTION_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR FUNCTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR MESSAGE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR DOC_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR DOC_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') ) ORDER BY START_DATE DESC, START_TIME DESC
SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ${DBO} AND TABLE_NAME LIKE CONCAT(${TABLE_NAME}, '%')
